src/types.ts.name: Permission record shapes
src/types.ts.description: Defines what a napplet identity and its permission record hold, the older numbered capability flags, and the default storage limit.

src/check.ts.name: Yes or no check
src/check.ts.description: Answers whether a napplet may use a capability: blocked napplets never may, unknown ones follow the default stance.

src/mutations.ts.name: Permission changes
src/mutations.ts.description: Grants, revokes, blocks, unblocks and sets storage limits, always returning a new copy, and turns records into text and back.

src/migrate.ts.name: Old record upgrade
src/migrate.ts.description: Rewrites saved permission records keyed by publisher, name and hash into the current name-and-hash form.
